requirement_and_acceptance: Purchase safeguards transaction shall enforce configured size and color: sized products require a listed size; unsized products reject size; non-demo products with color options require a listed color; demo-photo/no-color products reject color. qa_focus: Missing/invented option, absent/malformed key, exact replay after depletion, changed items/address/payment, cross-customer keys

It blocks mutating HTTP methods and known helper/logout paths, and fails attempted writes. It does not authenticate, submit commerce/customer/admin changes or establish their acceptance. requirement_and_acceptance: Every non-admin page shows a bottom-right Ask Zeouf launcher opening a non-modal panel named Zeouf Shopping Assistant. Warm neutral surfaces, wine/brown accents, editorial typography, a product/size/bag welcome and icon suggestions match the store. AI-answer warning and privacy reminder stay visible in the footer. Escape closes and restores launcher focus; opening focuses input; Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a newline and IME composition does not submit. Messages are escaped, duplicate sends blocked and errors offer applicable Retry. New conversation clears chat/comparisons/pending work and returns the log to the welcome top. Confirm success offers View bag, closing chat and opening the existing drawer.
qa_focus: Welcome/copy/privacy, focus/keyboard/IME, mobile layout, escaped HTML, retry/reset/top position, View bag, no admin launcher

requirement_and_acceptance: POST /api/assistant shall keep GROQ_API_KEY server-side, use Groq Responses API with default openai/gpt-oss-20b or nonblank GROQ_MODEL, and limit each address to 10 requests/minute. No OpenAI credential fallback or automatic SDK retries; each provider call times out after 25 seconds. One 35-second server deadline covers body, limiter, auth, catalog and every model round; confirmation has a 10-second server deadline. Disconnect/deadline cancels supported provider/auth/catalog/limiter fetches, settles waits and prevents subsequent rounds; cancelled/timed-out requests return safe 504 responses when connected. It accepts 1–50 messages, validates/processes only the last 12, each trimmed to nonblank text of at most 1,000 characters with user/assistant roles and a final user message. Raw body length above 24,000 JavaScript characters gives 413, not a measured byte limit. Invalid input gives 400 before model configuration is checked. Missing key for valid free-text chat or unavailable production limiter gives 503; valid card interactions need no key. Address/provider quota gives safe 429; other model failures give 502.
qa_focus: SDK URL/auth/signal/model, complete-operation deadline, hanging auth/catalog, disconnect/no late rounds, keyless actions, quota/no retries, shape/history/body boundaries, production limiter

requirement_and_acceptance: Tools shall read catalog facts, validate arguments and label authored text untrusted. Category filters match whole names or category prefixes/aliases, never men inside womens; subcategory phrases remain supported. Search/related returns at most eight products and replies at most three catalog-derived cards; invented IDs are dropped. Availability uses only configured sizes and their unique valid stock rows; missing/duplicate/retired rows never infer stock from the product total. Requested-size searches check that size. Demo contact-sheet products do not offer selectable colors, matching checkout. Server-rendered replies use tool-composed copy and catalog fields; raw model prose and descriptive instructions are never shown as factual answers. No-tool replies use a safe fallback. Recommendations remain cached for 30 seconds and model intent/tool selection still requires live evaluation (G-26).
qa_focus: Men/women/legacy aliases/subcategory boundaries, size-stock rules, factual renderer, malicious model/product text, invented IDs, failed lookups, cache age

requirement_and_acceptance: getCart shall require a verified customer bearer token, accept up to 30 valid browser-supplied lines and price them from catalog data (cached normally; fresh request snapshot for referenced follow-ups). Cart lines and totals render deterministically in display currency with INR base values. Anonymous/invalid tokens receive sign-in-required output. This is not an account-owned database cart; browser cart remains shared across accounts (G-10). Isolation follows AST-07. No order/account/checkout/payment tools exist.
qa_focus: Verified token, client price tampering, currency totals, fresh references, browser ownership, removed products, account switch

requirement_and_acceptance: addToCart shall propose without mutating after a verified session, intent flag and keyword heuristic; listed options and quantity 1-10 use cached stock including bag quantities across colors sharing the same product/size. Card Review bag addition submits explicit selected options through the same tool without a model. Confirm calls POST /api/assistant/confirm with bearer token, INR proposal price/options/quantity and up to 30 valid cart lines. Server identity and fresh uncached validation reject removed products 404, changed price/options or insufficient combined stock 409, invalid payload 400/413, missing identity 401, address limit 429 and unavailable limiter/stock 503; cancellation/deadline returns 504. It saves nothing and reserves no stock. Client session/cart checks and duplicate prevention mark Sent to your bag only after CartContext accepts the addition for the expected account. Checkout remains authoritative (G-26).
qa_focus: Selected options, fresh identity/price/stock checks, INR under USD display, combined bag stock, timeout/retry/double click, actual cart outcome, no reservation

requirement_and_acceptance: Store-policy tool, deterministic reply and prompt shall match portfolio-demo copy: no charges, shipment/delivery, shipping services, exchanges, returns or support follow-up. requirement_and_acceptance: Assistant history may include zero to three unique ordered productIds per assistant entry, each a nonblank trimmed string of at most 100 characters; user entries may not supply this field. Invalid retained references return 400. For free-text follow-ups the server freshly reloads the most recent nonempty reference list, supplies catalog facts and original positions to the model, and explicitly marks removed IDs unavailable without shifting positions. Browser-supplied names/prices/options are never authoritative. References outside the retained 12-message window are forgotten.
qa_focus: Second-one follow-up, changed price/options, removed first item, duplicate/oversized references, fresh-read failure, bounded-history loss

requirement_and_acceptance: Chat sends the storefront display currency and rate. Missing display defaults to INR/1; only INR/1 or USD with a finite positive rate up to 1000 is accepted, otherwise 400. Currency/rate are presentation input, never purchase-price authority. Budget tools default to display currency; explicit priceCurrency INR/USD overrides it and conversion to catalog INR happens once on the server. USD filters require an available USD display rate, otherwise request an INR budget. Cards, cart summaries and suggestions follow display currency; stored/proposed/confirmed prices stay INR. Display rounds to whole units; numeric budget filtering uses unrounded conversion.
qa_focus: INR/USD card/prose/suggestions, explicit rupees under USD, zero/invalid rate, unavailable USD rate, exact budget boundary, unchanged INR confirmation

requirement_and_acceptance: Product cards show catalog category, optional brand, configured sizes with unavailable sizes disabled, and selectable colors under checkout rules. Compare selects two or three unique products in selection order; a fourth is not added and Clear selection resets. Find similar and Compare selected submit validated interactions through POST /api/assistant with no model/key requirement. Review bag addition requires all listed size/color choices and integer quantity 1-10, proposes only through AST-05 and never mutates before Confirm. Missing products/options/stock use safe notices. Interactions share chat address limits/deadlines and retry preserves the selected action.
qa_focus: Mobile card controls, 2/3/4 comparison bounds, similar results, invalid/removed IDs, required/disabled options, quantity, keyless tool execution, no premature add

requirement_and_acceptance: Assistant opening/closing, incoming messages, loading dots, hover/selection and confirmation feedback use scoped CSS motion. Closing immediately makes the panel inert/hidden to assistive technology and removes it after 180 ms; reopening cancels pending removal. Reduced motion disables animations/transitions and uses immediate scrolling/closure. The panel fits 320px/390px mobile and desktop viewports; VisualViewport resize/scroll updates height/keyboard offset while retaining a non-modal layout. Composer grows with text up to 128px, then scrolls. New content follows the bottom only while the reader is near it; scrolling earlier replies preserves that position and offers Latest message. Sending or Latest message resumes following. Empty welcome starts at the top and has no Latest message control.
qa_focus: Motion preference, inert close/quick reopen, 320/390px bounds, simulated keyboard viewport, multiline growth/Shift+Enter, reader position and resume; real-device keyboard checks remain separate
